* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Half Bridge LLC Resonant DC-DC Converter
* Auto-grounded net 1 due to VIN:-
* Created internal net n11 for RSN_P:neg -> CSN_P:pos
* Created internal net n12 for RSN_S1:neg -> CSN_S1:pos
* Created internal net n13 for RSN_S2:neg -> CSN_S2:pos
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.model nmos_model NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=30 Cbd=1n Cbs=1n Cgdo=100p Is=1e-14 Tt=100n Rs=0.01)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.3 Cjo=3e-11 Tt=0 Bv=50 Ibv=1e-06)
* --- Center-tapped Transformer (parametric, series-R + core loss) ---
* NOTE: Rct is a HIGH-impedance resistor (typically 100meg-1gig Ohms) that provides DC bias
* for the secondary side to prevent SPICE singular matrix / convergence failures.
* It does NOT break electrical isolation - leakage current is negligible (~1pA).
.subckt Xctfmr P1 P2 S1 S2 CT params: Lm=100u Ns=3.6 K1=0.99 K2=0.99 K12=0.99 Rwp=0.1 Rws1=0.05 Rws2=0.05 Rcore=1e12 Cww1=5e-11 Cww2=5e-11 Rct=100meg
Rwp P1 P1a {Rwp}
Rws1 S1 S1a {Rws1}
Rws2 S2 S2a {Rws2}
Lp P1a P2 {Lm}
Ls1 S1a CT {Lm*Ns*Ns}
Ls2 S2a CT {Lm*Ns*Ns}
K1 Lp Ls1 {K1}
K2 Lp Ls2 {K2}
K12 Ls1 Ls2 {K12}
Rcore P1a P2 {Rcore}
Cww1 P1a S1a {Cww1}
Cww2 P1a S2a {Cww2}
Rct CT 0 {Rct}
.ends Xctfmr

VIN VIN_src 0 DC 24
RVIN_series VIN_src n0 0.01
VSW1_SENSE n0 n_SW1_dsense 0
MSW1 n_SW1_dsense n3 n2 n2 nmos_model
VSW2_SENSE n2 n_SW2_dsense 0
MSW2 n_SW2_dsense n4 0 0 nmos_model
VCr_SENSE n6 n_Cr_sense 0
LCr_ESL n_Cr_sense n_Cr_esl 1e-10
RCr_ESR n_Cr_esl n_Cr_esr 0.1
Cr n_Cr_esr 0 2.2e-07
RCr_LEAK n6 0 1e+14
VLr_SENSE n2 n_Lr_sense 0
RLr_ESR n_Lr_sense n_Lr_ser 0.05
Lr n_Lr_ser n5 1e-05
CLr_par n2 n5 3e-11
RLr_core n2 n5 1e+06
VT1_SENSE_PRI n5 n_T1_p1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC1 n7 n_T1_s1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC2 n8 n_T1_s2_sense 0
XT1 n_T1_p1_sense n6 n_T1_s1_sense n_T1_s2_sense n9 Xctfmr Lm=0.0001 Ns=1.2 K1=0.98 K2=-0.98 K12=-0.98 Rwp=0.1 Rws1=0.05 Rws2=0.05 Rcore=1e+06 Cww1=2e-11 Cww2=2e-11 Rct=1e+08 Cct=0
RSN_P n2 n11 50
CSN_P n11 0 1e-09
RSN_S1 n7 n12 50
CSN_S1 n12 n10 1e-09
RSN_S2 n8 n13 50
CSN_S2 n13 n10 1e-09
R_ISO n9 0 1e+08
VD1_SENSE n7 n_D1_sense 0
RD1_SENSE_DAMP n_D1_sense n_D1_damp 0.001
D1 n_D1_damp n10 Dmodel
VD2_SENSE n8 n_D2_sense 0
RD2_SENSE_DAMP n_D2_sense n_D2_damp 0.001
D2 n_D2_damp n10 Dmodel
VCout_SENSE n10 n_Cout_sense 0
LCout_ESL n_Cout_sense n_Cout_esl 1e-10
RCout_ESR n_Cout_esl n_Cout_esr 0.02
Cout n_Cout_esr n9 0.00047
RCout_LEAK n10 n9 5e+06
VRout_SENSE n10 n_Rout_sense 0
LRout_PL n_Rout_sense n_Rout_mid 1e-08
Rout n_Rout_mid n9 10
VPWM1 n_PWM1_int n2 PULSE(0 12 0 1e-07 1e-07 4.4e-06 1e-05)
RPWM1_drive n_PWM1_int n3 100
VPWM2 n_PWM2_int 0 PULSE(0 12 5e-06 1e-07 1e-07 4.4e-06 1e-05)
RPWM2_drive n_PWM2_int n4 100

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc

* Transient Requirement tr_startup: Startup transient from 0V to regulated 12V output. LLC resonant converter is NON-INVERTING (output positive terminal at [Rout, pos] and [Cout, pos]). Measure VOUT at [Rout, pos] or [Cout, pos]. Verify soft-start behavior with minimal inrush current and overshoot.
tran 1e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let vout_final_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran vout_final avg vout_final_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print vout_final
let vout_peak_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran vout_peak max vout_peak_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print vout_peak
meas tran iin_peak max i(vin) from=0.012 to=0.015
print iin_peak
let VOUT_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran t_settle TRIG AT=0.0001 TARG VOUT_diff VAL=11.399999999999999 CROSS=LAST
print t_settle
wrdata time_series/tr_startup_IIN.csv i(vin)
let VIN = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/tr_startup_VIN.csv v(n0)
let VOUT_csv_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
let VOUT = VOUT_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/tr_startup_VOUT.csv VOUT_csv_diff
let v_SW1_auto = v(n0) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_SW1.csv v_SW1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_SW1.csv i(VSW1_SENSE)
let v_SW1_gate_auto = v(n3) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/Gate_SW1.csv v_SW1_gate_auto
let v_SW2_auto = v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_SW2.csv v_SW2_auto
wrdata time_series/I_SW2.csv i(VSW2_SENSE)
let v_SW2_gate_auto = v(n4)
wrdata time_series/Gate_SW2.csv v_SW2_gate_auto
let v_Cr_auto = v(n6)
wrdata time_series/V_Cr.csv v_Cr_auto
wrdata time_series/I_Cr.csv i(VCr_SENSE)
let v_Lr_auto = v(n2) - v(n5)
wrdata time_series/V_Lr.csv v_Lr_auto
wrdata time_series/I_Lr.csv i(VLr_SENSE)
let v_T1_auto = v(n5) - v(n6)
wrdata time_series/V_T1.csv v_T1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_T1_pri.csv i(VT1_SENSE_PRI)
wrdata time_series/I_T1_sec.csv i(VT1_SENSE_SEC1)
wrdata time_series/I_T1.csv i(VT1_SENSE_PRI)

wrdata time_series/V_D1.csv v_D1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D1.csv i(VD1_SENSE)
let v_D2_auto = v(n8) - v(n10)
